mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pass_code (appointment_id, code, status, max_use_count, used_count, valid_from, valid_until) VALUES (#{appointmentId}, #{code}, #{status}, #{maxUseCount}, #{usedCount}, #{validFrom}, #{validUntil})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pass_code WHERE appointment_id = #{appointmentId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pass_code SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE pass_code SET used_count = used_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND used_count < #{maxUseCount}
UPDATE pass_code SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE appointment_id = #{appointmentId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pass_code WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND valid_until < #{now}
